subject: Post-call: FinEdge evaluation — model diffs & proposed pin/rollback
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Doe <alex.doe@finedge.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@finedge.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: FinEdge evaluation — recommended next steps

Hi Alex / Priya — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the evaluation: 

Summary from the call:
- Primary objective: improve invoice classification recall on multi-line receipts while keeping hallucination rate < 1.5% for extracted vendor names.
- Current baseline: FinEdge is demoing a hosted open model with heavy prompt templates; latency target is 300ms p95 for top-100 customers.
- Key constraint: PII retention rules require no request logging beyond token-level metrics in-prod for the pilot.

Redwood recommendations for the evaluation pack (attached):
1) Model candidates to benchmark (explainers in the attached eval pack):
   - redwood-rlm-3b-quant (fast, lower token cost; strong structured-extraction baseline)
   - rwl-13b-8bit (higher quality for edge-case vendor inference; slightly higher latency)
2) Baseline prompt set: prompt_set_finedge_v3.jsonl (attached). Includes 120 seeded examples covering multi-line totals, nested vendor tags, and OCR noise.
3) Metrics & acceptance criteria: recall >= 92% on primary extraction tasks, hallucination rate <= 1.5% across the set, and end-to-end latency p95 <= 300ms.
4) Pines/rollouts: if you want stable behaviour during the contract pilot, we recommend pinning to a specific model-version for the pilot (we can pin to redwood-rlm-3b-quant:v1.2) and enabling a canary route for periodic evaluation on the newer 13b variant.

Links / artifacts:
- Evaluation pack (PDF) + prompt set attached.
- Benchmark workspace: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDEF_gDriveEvalFolder
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-14287

Next steps (proposed):
- Alex/Priya: confirm the prioritized acceptance tests (2–3 seed tickets) by EOD Tue 17 Feb.
- Redwood (Rishi + Monica): spin up a pinned endpoint and run the baseline batch. Expect initial batch results within 36 hours after we get the seed set.
- If you want rollback/pin controls in the contract, we can include a model-pinning clause and an SLA for rollback windows.

If helpful I can slot a short tech walkthrough with Rishi and Monica tomorrow to show the eval dashboard and how the canary traffic will be routed.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: finedge_eval_pack_v2.pdf, prompt_set_finedge_v3.jsonl

From: Priya Sharma <priya@finedge.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Alex Doe <alex.doe@finedge.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Feb 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: FinEdge evaluation — recommended next steps

Thanks Jasmine — the plan looks good. Quick update from our side after running the initial integration: 

- We ran a small batch (50 invoices) against the pinned model you stood up and saw overall recall ~93%, good signal.
- However, after your service pushed a platform model update on Fri night (we saw model id change to rwl-13b-8bit:v2.0 for a subset of traffic), a subset of invoices that previously extracted 'Vendor Name' correctly are now populating with empty strings or spurious vendor labels.

I've attached a short sample (regression_samples_0217.csv) with three examples where outputs differ; one example shows a clear hallucination (vendor replaced with unrelated product name). The timing suggests this started after the v2 rollout you mentioned. Can we pause any automatic model-roll updates for our pilot and consider pinning until we triage?

Also — we rely on stable structured output to feed our reconciliation pipeline, so even small quality regressions are high-risk. Happy to do a short screen share to walk you through the failing cases.

Best,
Priya Sharma
Engineering Lead, Data & Ops | FinEdge
priya@finedge.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@finedge.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: FinEdge evaluation — recommended next steps

Priya — thanks for the clear examples and for flagging the timing. We dug into the routing logs and can confirm a canary rollout of rwl-13b-8bit:v2.0 was active for ~5% of traffic starting 2026-02-13 02:00 UTC. That can explain the divergence. 

Proposed immediate remediation (low-friction path):
1) Pause automatic canary rollouts for your accounts and pin live traffic to redwood-rlm-3b-quant:v1.2 — we can enact this within 30 minutes and it requires no code change from your side.
2) We will run a focused A/B where we evaluate the v2.0 outputs on a mirrored set (no production write-through) for two days to gather diff metrics and regression rates.
3) If regression rate > 1.5% for the seeded acceptance tests you confirm, we will roll back the v2.0 canary and open a compensating action.
4) Timeline: pin now (T+0), mirrored run (T+1 to T+2 days), decision meeting (T+3).

Operational notes:
- We will provide a diffs.csv and a short runbook with example minimization steps. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-rollback
- If you prefer immediate rollback rather than mirrored evaluation, we can do that as well — just confirm and we will rollback rwl-13b-8bit:v2.0 for your account and restore v1.2.

Monica will coordinate the pinned endpoint and give you the dashboard link with token-level latency and token-cost breakdown.

Apologies for the disruption — we treat regressions like high-severity incidents and will prioritize the triage.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@finedge.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: FinEdge evaluation — recommended next steps

Hi Priya — we can absolutely pin now. Per Rishi's plan we will: 

- Pin FinEdge production traffic to redwood-rlm-3b-quant:v1.2 immediately (actioning now).
- Spin up the mirrored evaluation for v2.0 and surface the diffs.csv and regression metrics to you by EOD Thu 19 Feb.
- Proposed decision meeting: Fri 20 Feb 09:00 PT — invite to follow once you confirm availability.

I've attached an updated evaluation pack (minor edits) that includes the three prioritized acceptance tests you called out on the call. Please reply with a quick confirmation that pin + mirrored evaluation works for you and whether you want the immediate rollback option instead.

Thanks for moving quickly on this — we want to make sure your reconciliation pipeline stays stable.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: finedge_eval_pack_v2.pdf (updated)
